en.headline: Overall crime falls 1.5 per cent in first half as phishing scams surge
en.dek: Police recorded 42,736 offences in the first six months of 2026, down 671 cases from a year earlier, while phishing fraud rose about 61 per cent.
body: Overall crime in Hong Kong fell 1.5 per cent in the first half of 2026, with 42,736 cases recorded, 671 fewer than the same period last year, according to figures released on Friday.

Violent crime dropped 5 per cent to 4,144 cases. Most categories declined, including burglary, theft, criminal damage and blackmail, with reductions ranging from about 3.2 per cent to 40 per cent. Fraud remained the largest category at 20,613 cases, down 0.7 per cent and accounting for 48 per cent of all crime. The amount involved was HK$3.51 billion, slightly lower than a year earlier.

Online fraud made up about 57 per cent of all deception cases, with 11,727 reports. While online job and investment scams fell, phishing cases rose approximately 61 per cent. Fraudsters impersonated government departments or banks and used small-value, high-frequency techniques to trick victims into clicking links or entering account details on fake websites.
Police continue to urge the public to verify communications carefully and avoid sharing personal or banking information in response to unsolicited messages.

zh.headline: 上半年整體罪案跌1.5% 釣魚騙案升約六成
zh.dek: 今年首六個月錄得42,736宗罪案，較去年同期減少671宗；釣魚騙案則上升約61%。
body: 警方星期五公布，2026年上半年整體罪案共42,736宗，較去年同期減少671宗，下跌1.5%。
暴力罪案有4,144宗，按年減少5%。大部分罪案類別錄得跌幅，包括爆竊、盜竊、刑事毀壞及勒索，減幅由約3.2%至40%不等。詐騙案有20,613宗，按年微跌0.7%，佔整體罪案48%，涉款35.1億元，較去年同期略低。
網上騙案佔整體詐騙案約57%，共11,727宗。網上求職及投資騙案錄得下跌，但釣魚騙案上升約61%。騙徒假冒政府部門或銀行，以「細金額、多次數」手法誘騙受害人點擊連結或在虛假網站填寫帳戶及個人資料。
警方繼續呼籲市民小心核實來歷不明的訊息，切勿向陌生人提供個人或銀行資料。
